about: When a message joins the one above it under a single avatar and name, as in Slack: the same person sent it less than five minutes after the message above. A new day always starts a new group, which each app's own tests cover. Each message gives its sender and the seconds since the first message; grouped lists, per message, whether it joins the one above.

cases.name: A message right after the same person's joins it
Just under five minutes still joins
Five minutes apart starts a new group
Another person's message starts a new group
Coming back after someone else starts a new group
The window runs from the message above, not from the group's first
